acceptanceCriteria: 知识投影、状态/Outcome 投影和生命周期职责在现有 cockpit-repository crate 内形成清晰模块边界，公开 re-export 与调用方保持兼容。
lifecycle.rs 不再使用 use super::*，改为显式依赖；编译器与静态检查证明没有通过通配导入隐藏的模块耦合。
现有 repository 单元/集成测试及受影响 CLI/MCP 兼容测试通过，治理 receipt 与投影行为没有语义改写。
变更只改善维护边界；验证报告不宣称性能收益，未完成的职责迁移保留为明确后续范围。
goal: 将 repository 根模块中可独立验证的知识投影、状态/Outcome 投影与生命周期编排边界整理为同 crate 模块，逐步替换 lifecycle.rs 的通配导入；不改变公开签名、协议行为、receipt 语义或性能结论。
intent: 在 cockpit-repository 现有 crate 内按用例拆分职责，并以显式模块依赖保持公开接口与治理行为稳定。
outOfScope: 不拆分新 crate；不改变公开函数签名或序列化协议；不修改 cockpit-cli、cockpit-mcp、cockpit-protocol、发布脚本或历史兼容语义；不以模块拆分宣称运行加速。

scenarioCoverage.expected: Existing cockpit-repository exports and downstream CLI/MCP callers compile without signature or serialization changes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run repository library/tests and focused CLI/MCP compatibility tests; compare public re-export surface and receipt fixtures.

scenarioCoverage.expected: lifecycle.rs uses explicit root/module imports and no use super::* wildcard; behavior remains unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run cargo fmt/check/tests and static rg assertion for wildcard imports, then inspect the resulting module imports.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Knowledge, status, Outcome, and lifecycle projections preserve existing JSON facts, identity bindings, and failure boundaries.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run knowledge, status, outcome, lifecycle, archive, and recovery repository integration tests.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The change creates use-case modules inside cockpit-repository only; no new crate, protocol, CLI/MCP, release, or compatibility behavior is introduced.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect the diff and run package tests with the Contract scope bound to cockpit-repository source.
